title: Three Days, Two Deaths, Three Plagues
description: The structural moments of the deeper work. T41 — three Great Days of regeneration met by two deaths: the Day of descent and refining, the Day of enthronement in the new aeon, the Day of unveiling in the Father's hidden storehouses; the temporal mingling that ends in fire, and the eternal severance of what cannot be raised. T42 — three permanent works at the consummation: the new luminous land, the binding of self-love's fire, the fixed separation set with its great guard. T43 — three afflictions by which the self's claim is undone: its own forms turning to bind it, the great fire releasing what was hidden, and the final splitting in which the active and receptive forms of self-love are gathered to their sealed places forever.
